description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade and configuration helper functions for an embedded device Linux environment, including functions for device detection, copying configs, flashing firmware, and performing upgrades.

methods.name: platform_get_rootfs
methods.description: Retrieves the root filesystem device based on kernel command line parameters.

methods.name: platform_get_n821_disk
methods.description: Gets the device path for the N821 disk based on a given partition number.

methods.name: platform_copy_config_helper
methods.description: Copies backup configuration to a device, mounting it temporarily.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration based on specific board names.

methods.name: platform_do_flash
methods.description: Performs flashing of kernel and root filesystem from a tar archive to a device.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Coordinates the upgrade process by determining target devices and invoking flashing routines.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Validates the upgrade image for supported boards.
